void_key.name: Void Key
void_key.description: Opens the east lattice gate from the Dragon Realm.

dragon_tear.name: Dragon Tear
dragon_tear.description: Weeping gold from a fallen wyrm. Counts toward victory.

lattice_shard.name: Lattice Shard
lattice_shard.description: A stable fragment of repaired reality. Counts toward victory.

focusing_chip.name: Focusing Chip
focusing_chip.description: Stabilizes sanity on void navigation. Passive: −5 sanity loss on failed navigate.
